title: Declarative onboarding bundler, publish pipeline and canary retraction workflow
creator: Priya Natarajan
description: Build a declarative CI/CD flow that takes a model bundle (model artifact + manifest + perf-profile), performs automated signing and provenance capture, publishes a staged performance profile, and manages a canary rollout with automated retraction/rollback when regressions are detected. This ticket focuses on the orchestration glue (bundler + publisher + retraction policy) and does not change runtime kernel code.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New 'bundler' job takes inputs from model-registry and produces a versioned artifact with deterministic fingerprint; 2) Signing/attestation metadata written to provenance ledger and visible in the model-catalog UI; 3) Publisher creates staged perf-profile and pins the model version as a candidate for canary; 4) Canary deploy runs automatically against a synthetic traffic harness and real shadow traffic for a configurable observation window; 5) If automated checks detect regression thresholds, the system retracts the canary and marks the candidate as failed with an error reason; 6) All steps logged, PRs/links recorded in ticket, and end-to-end test against a small Llama-based model included in CI.
implementation_notes:
- Introduce a declarative manifest schema (v1) for bundler: inputs, quantization-profile, expected latency SLOs, benchmarks to run.
- Bundler will run in a hermetic builder pod, produce a signed tarball and a 'profile.json' artifact.
- Use existing attestation service to sign artifacts; extend ledger schema to store 'bundle_source_commit' and 'seed_hash'.
- Publisher service will validate the profile against a set of gating rules (timing distribution, top-k hallucination checks from our eval harness) before staging.
- Add a retraction policy engine: rules + thresholds + window. The engine must support immediate rollback and a graceful roll-forward path when transient errors are observed.
- Ensure rollouts are idempotent and support manual override from Console.
- Backfill audit logs for compliance and exportable CSV for SRE/CS teams.
progress_updates: 2025-11-12: Spec drafted and reviewed with PM and Security. 2025-11-15: POC bundler implemented that produces deterministic tarball for open-llama-7b. 2025-11-18: Ledger schema change PR opened (github.com/redwood-inference/attestation/pull/214). 2025-11-21: Publisher gating rules prototype validated against 3 synthetic workloads. 2025-11-25: Canary harness integrated with canary-metrics pipeline; initial thresholds tuned. 2025-11-28: First end-to-end run in staging completed; observed flaky p99 latency spikes—investigating batching edge-case in harness.
risks:
- False positives in regression detection could cause repeated retractions and slow onboarding.
- Signing/attestation latency could lengthen CI cycles if not parallelized.
- Deterministic bundle creation needs strict hermetic builds; non-determinism may break pinning.
- Dependencies on ledger migrations (ENG-41213) could block rollout.
- Shadow traffic might not be representative of production for some workloads, masking issues.
qa_plan:
- Unit tests for manifest parser and bundler fingerprinting.
- Integration test that runs the full flow against a canned model with synthetic requests and asserts profile stability.
- Chaos tests to simulate transient GPU contention and validate retraction policy behaves as expected.
- Manual QA: run onboarding flow for two internal models and validate Console shows provenance and canary state.
- Post-deploy: monitor canary failure rate, rollback frequency, and mean time to retract for 2 weeks.
rollout_plan:
1) Deploy bundler and publisher to staging (canary disabled) and run 20 successful onboards. 2) Enable canary for internal-only projects and run 10 staged rollouts. 3) Open beta for teams with opt-in 'auto-retract' enabled. 4) Gradually flip default to auto-retract off->on with safety toggles at org level.
Emergency rollback: manual revoke of published profile via Console which triggers immediate revert to previous pinned model; documented runbook in /confluence/model-cd/retraction-runbook.
metrics_to_monitor:
- Canary pass rate (percent of canaries that finish w/o retraction)
- Mean time to retract (minutes)
- Onboard cycle time (minutes from bundle start to published profile)
- Attestation latency (seconds)
- Post-deploy regression deltas: p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost delta, quality eval score delta
- Number of manual overrides per week
notes_for_reviewers:
- Please focus on attestation schema compatibility with existing ledger designs.
- Review the gating rule set: are thresholds conservative enough to prevent noisy retractions?
- Security: confirm KMS changes required for signing are documented in ENG-41213.
- UX: console visibility for staged profiles should make provenance and failure reasons obvious.
- Ops: verify runbook for manual revoke includes RBAC steps for customers on Private deployments.
